title: How to make a good cup of tea
text:
How to make a good cup of tea

1. Put water in the kettle and boil it.
2. Put a tea bag in a cup.
3. Pour the hot water into the cup.
4. Wait for three or four minutes. Don't wait too long, or the tea can be bitter.
5. Take the tea bag out.
6. Add milk or lemon if you like. Some people like sugar, too.
7. Wait a minute. The tea is very hot!

Enjoy your tea!
